# Permitted values for the `agent:` field of the Generated-By commit trailer.
# One per line; blank lines and # comments ignored.
#
# The grammar of the trailer is enforced strictly and this vocabulary is not:
# extending it takes a reviewed pull request. The split is deliberate. A gate
# that is hard to satisfy honestly produces dishonest data -- if CI rejected an
# unknown agent name outright, the cheapest route back to green would be to
# write a wrong-but-allowed value, and the provenance trail would quietly
# become fiction.
wayfinder
implementer
verifier
